data.name: Ingeberg
data.gender_notes: Ingeberg is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old Norse, Ingeberg means 'belonging to Inge', a Scandinavian name derived from 'inge', meaning 'belonging to Inge', and 'berg', meaning 'mountain'. This name signifies strength and a connection to the land. The name Ingeberg carries the meaning “Inge, mountain, strong” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ingeberg usually hope their child will grow to embody inge, mountain, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
